title: Display Glucose notifications on Android Auto
body:
It would be great if the xdrip App too ocmpatible with androidauto and the blood glucose value in the car could display.
https://www.android.com/auto/

comments.body:
You can currently have the Bg announced through the car speakers every 5 minutes with a simple Tasker profile.

I asked @jamorham about Android Auto compatibility a few weeks ago so it would display Bg and he declined because he thought it would be too distracting.

Hi!

To @FranzMo's point, and perhaps disagreeing with @jamorham, right now what happens is that I take the phone and look into it to check my BG, while I could get the same info while looking to the main screen of my car.

So, although I understand the rational, in fact, not having the feature there is more distracting than having it, just because if I truly want to know my BG I will know it, independently of having it on Android Auto or not.

I can volunteer to implement the feature if @jamorham gives is 👍 to it!

Hi All, and especially Jose,
I would also like Android Auto to display xDrip+ information, and have also
been thinking of implementing this.
Cheers
